_comment: The innkeeper narrates the site, one line per chapter (section ids in index.html). scripts/voice/generate.mjs synthesises public/audio/narrator/<id>.mp3. Facts only from the CV.

lines.intro: Ah — you found his notice. That's Anton Duchenko, full-stack developer. Pull up a stool, I'll tell you what I know.
lines.about: He likes to own a feature from end to end — from the data model to the last pixel. Used to be a ship's electro-technical officer, if you can believe it.
lines.work: These are the quests he's taken. Releaf, where he works now. The Levels, a language-learning app with AI inside. And a phone store he built with his crew.
lines.experience: Three companies so far — Maxopen, Nitrix Soft, and now Binary Studio. At every stop he made things faster: pages, queries, delivery.
lines.skills: His armoury: TypeScript, React and Node.js, a good deal of SQL, and a knack for plugging AI into real products.
lines.education: Learned his trade at Mate Academy. Before that, the maritime academy in Kherson.
lines.contact: Got a quest for him? Send a raven. He answers quickly.
